extraction_notes: Ordering-code identity: SI2343CDS-T1-GE3; the supplied datasheet identifies the die family as Si2343DS and shows marking code Si2343DS (F3).
Datasheet branding is Vishay Siliconix; manufacturer field follows the supplied manufacturer identity Vishay Intertech.

P-channel polarity is preserved in tabulated VDS, VGS, ID, and IS values as signed quantities. Curves are plotted with positive voltage/current/charge magnitudes because the datasheet axes use positive magnitudes for this P-channel device.

The electrical-characteristics heading specifies TJ = 25 degC unless otherwise noted. Dynamic values are design-aid typical values and are not subject to production testing where the datasheet says so.
Gate-threshold voltage has no typical table entry: MIN is -1 V and MAX is -3 V at VDS = VGS and ID = -250 uA. The signed ordering is retained rather than converted to magnitudes.

The VSD table gives typical +0.7 V and prints maximum -1.2 V under IS = -1.0 A; the extracted body-diode spec stores the typical positive forward-voltage magnitude and the diode curve uses positive VSD and |IS| axes.
Ciss, Coss, and Crss are typical table values in pF converted to SI farads: 540 pF = 5.4e-10 F, 131 pF = 1.31e-10 F, and 105 pF = 1.05e-10 F.

Curve points are manual reads from the plotted traces only. The output, transfer, capacitance, gate-charge, diode, and on-resistance curves are typical characteristics; no values were interpolated from a fitted model.
The transfer figure does not state its VDS bias, so the curve condition records that omission instead of inferring a bias from another table row.
The datasheet lists Qg = 14 nC typical and 21 nC maximum at VDS = -15 V, ID = -4.0 A, VGS = -10 V; the gate-charge plot was digitized as a curve but Qg is not a field in this extraction schema.
The datasheet provides thermal resistance and switching-time data, but those quantities are not represented by fields in this strict extraction schema.
